critical_code_review_comments: server.py bind_referral (line 1503): grants lottery_bonus_draws to inviter and logs 邀請成功, but does NOT bump invited count or write a log for the invitee's side; current invited counter increment is in the same $inc call, OK. Logic looks correct and idempotent (guarded by referred_by).
server.py lottery_draw (line 612) hardcodes count=10 or 1 — any body.count value >=10 collapses to 10 and anything else to 1; this is intentional but a comment would improve clarity.

ActivityCenter.jsx auto-binds pending ref_code with .catch(()=>{}) silently swallowing errors; a non-success bind (self-code, already-bound, 404) is only surfaced to the inviter path. For the invitee, no toast if bind fails. Consider surfacing bind errors as a non-blocking toast.

InviteLotteryAdmin.jsx save() always forces invite_only=true, cost_points=0, free_daily=false — correct for current invite-only model, but if admin wants to re-enable paid/daily later this requires code change. Fine as-is per PRD.
